notes: News & Support on Limpid OS's page: what we write for everyone, and your support tickets.
Album pictures come in the size each place shows them, and long lists scroll smoothly even with thousands of songs.
An album opened from Search leaves out the songs you hid and the hidden duplicates, as Music does.
The sidebar now runs along the window's edge.
Download Remote App goes away once a phone has connected.
Deezer joins TIDAL and Qobuz on the Streaming page: add it to Lyrion, sign in and play it in Limpid.
Add albums and songs from Streaming to your Music with Add to Library. They show in Music with Lyrion's mark and the service's name, and play through Lyrion.
Show Hidden is now an eye button, the last of the Music page's buttons.
